params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. A salad in a round white paper takeout bowl: chopped romaine lettuce topped with black beans, sweet corn, pico de gallo, crumbled white cheese and crunchy tortilla strips, with a small cup of pale green cilantro-lime dressing beside it. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
